expected_rate: One durable decision row after each completed session when F6 is enabled; no runtime rows while F6 remains disabled.
reversal: Any F6 starter uses the current bar in its own cutoff, accepts a stale/nonfinite/incomplete distribution, lacks independent stress confirmation, or sends an order when exact evidence cannot be appended.

metrics.name: Empirical F6 starter evidence integrity
metrics.bound: Every decision is current-session, uses strictly prior completed SPY bars, carries both empirical cutoffs and the exact prior-record SHA256, and an executed event embeds the same evidence object.
